decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Lighting levels shall not exceed levels set out in Technical Report 5 of the Institute of Lighting Engineers - the Brightness of Illuminated Signs.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding Condition 2, the external lighting of the building hereby permitted shall not take place outside the following times: half an hour before dusk until 11pmwith the exception of the external lighting of the front and sculpture of the tower which shall not take place outside the following times half an hour before dusk until dawn.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding Condition 2 electrical engineers layout drawing 3838/W/E/1212 REV P1 (entitled "Wallis House Fa?ade Lighting Layout Planning Application" and dated Nov 07) is not hereby approved.  Electrical engineers layout drawing 3838/W/E/1212 REV P1 shall be amended to show nine lights to each of the building's wings so as to accord with the approved detail and the amended drawing shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority as a record and the relevant electrical work carried out in accordance with the same.

Condition : 6 - Calculations shall be submitted to show the illuminance results for the shoulders, wings and turrets of the building.  Details shall also be submitted indicating how compliance with the Institute of Lighting Engineers' Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light shall be achieved in respect of sky glow and confirming that the lighting for all facades (the external lighting proposed to the front, sides and sculpture of its tower and to its shoulders, wings and turrets) shall be in accordance with Table 1 of the Institute of Lighting Engineers' Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light for Environmental Zone E3.  The development shall then be carried out in accordance with same.
description: Installation of external lighting to the Listed Wallis House Building
